defaults.rollbackToGray: plugin.json lifecycleState active->gray after failed operational evidence or unresolved conflict
defaults.stateRationale: registered source, current consumer and operational fixtures are present
defaults.promotionCriteria: trigger precision requires real comparable work units; structural evidence alone cannot promote lifecycle state

brand-visual-quality.stateRationale: gray until prospective brand asset WorkUnits prove visual evidence value and bounded review cost
brand-visual-quality.promotionCriteria: three comparable WorkUnits or two independent projects with fresh lineage, parity, micro/mono, human acceptance and blocker-reset evidence
brand-visual-quality.rollbackToGray: remain or return gray when false positives, review cost, recurrence or design-system overlap exceed the accepted boundary

consumer-validation-engineering.stateRationale: gray until independent cross-repository consumer evidence covers at least two contexts
consumer-validation-engineering.promotionCriteria: two independent repositories with fresh identity, artifact and CI evidence plus acceptable correction rate

repair-prevention-assessment.stateRationale: active correctness gate extracted from the gray effectiveness program; deterministic schema, validator, positive/negative fixtures and mandatory repair consumers are operational
repair-prevention-assessment.promotionCriteria: not applicable: this unit owns repair completion correctness and does not claim prospective rework reduction
repair-prevention-assessment.rollbackToGray: fail closed for repair acceptance and revert consumer routing if runtime reachability or false-blocking evidence regresses

rework-prevention-engineering.stateRationale: gray until prospective ReworkEffectivenessLoop evidence reaches its sample threshold
rework-prevention-engineering.promotionCriteria: prospective comparable work units demonstrate benefit, bounded false positives and a tested rollback path
